rules.statement: In a Paulian action, the fact that consideration was given by the alienee does not afford him a complete defence where he has participated in a scheme to defraud the creditors.
rules.supporting_quote: "It may be that the first defendant and Sinniah will have difficulty in enforcing the agreement to reconvey should the second defendant refuse to do so. Those who enter into agreements of this nature do so with persons whom they believe they can trust to abide by them, and necessarily take the risk of possible loss in the event of their confidence proving to be misplaced."
